top_signals.title: Elon Musk says Trump is 'ultimately' responsible for any curbs on Ukraine's Starshield systems
top_signals.summary: "Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS," Musk wrote.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bonds Pay the Price for India’s Rupee Defense as Rate Bets Build
top_signals.summary: India’s fight to stabilize the rupee is starting to exact a price in the bond market, as traders ramp up bets on faster interest-rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Iron Ore Trades Below $90 a Ton for First Time Since 2024
top_signals.summary: Iron ore futures in Singapore slipped to a two-year low under $90 a ton, extending a retreat fueled by soft demand in China and too much global supply.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Australia Gets Its First Michelin Stars With 11 Top Restaurants
top_signals.summary: The Michelin Guide has handed out its first-ever stars in Australia to 11 restaurants in the state of South Australia.
